preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the timeout, disable profile startup for the read, extend the wrapper to sixty seconds, and read the unchanged file through EOF.

preferred_methods.rollback: Stop the read, retain the failure, and leave repository and external state unchanged.

preferred_methods.title: No-profile bounded full skill read after short-wrapper timeout
